record.dic_text:
1251 diakouomai {dee-ak-oo'-om-ahee}

源自 1223 與 191 關身語態; 動詞

欽定本 - hear 1; 1

1) 從頭聽到尾, 聽到最後, 仔細的聽, 完整的聽 (#徒23:35|)
record.edic_text:
1251 diakouomai {dee-ak-oo'-om-ahee}

middle voice from 1223 and 191;; v

AV - hear 1; 1

1) to hear one through, hear to the end, hear with care, hear fully

same.cexp: 聽見；留意；了解；恢復聽覺；聽從
拒絕聽；不理會或無意中聽到
聽從；回應，接受；應敲門聲出來開（門）
